Apurba’s 1971 drama ‘Nihoto Nokkhotro’ to release on Independence Day
2022-03-15T16:06:46+06:00 | Arts & Entertainment Desk
https://www.thedailystar.net/entertainment/tv-film/news/apurbas-1971-drama-nihoto-nokkhotro-release-independence-day-2983446

Television director Sanjoy Somadder's Liberation War-based fiction "Nihoto Nokkhotro", starring Ziaul Faruq Apurba, is set to air on RTV on Independence Day (March 26).

The production narrates the story of a member of Crack Platoon, a special commando team of the Mukti Bahini led by Major Khaled Mosharraf, which was formed in 1971 during the Liberation War.

Scripted by Ayan Ishtiaq, the tele-fiction, also features Monira Mithu, Joy Raj, and Sayeem Samad, among others.
